verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists 'Bring your own keys' as available only on higher tiers (No/No/Yes/Yes). Integration guides show external agents from OpenAI CUA, the Vercel AI SDK and CrewAI driving Notte browsers. That points to some model flexibility, but nothing documents which LLM providers Notte's own agent framework supports or how to configure them, and on lower tiers BYOK is unavailable. Missing for 10: documented list of supported LLM providers, configuration docs for swapping models in Notte agents, confirmation that BYOK covers LLM keys, BYOK on all tiers, and independent corroboration.
